transcript.text: Settlement total = sum of amount over completed orders where order_ts is in Q4 2025 (Oct 1 - Dec 31, 2025).

args.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cents FROM memory.bench.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
